page_title: LIV 2-0 AST | Liverpool v Aston Villa 09/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, David Coote has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Rough tackle by Luis Diaz (Liverpool). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Aston Villa have been awarded a free kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
87' The referee signals a substitution. Wataru Endo (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Alexis Mac Allister.
86' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) picks up an injury.
84' 2 - 0 Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Emiliano Martinez with a strike into the right side of the goal. He makes it 2:0.
82' Aston Villa take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
80' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
80' A quickly taken corner by Aston Villa.
79' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.
78' Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process. It's a free kick to Liverpool, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
77' The free kick is delivered by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
76' Today's referee David Coote rightly decides to book Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) for his harsh tackle.
74' Substitution. Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) on for Amadou Onana.
74' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) replaces Lucas Digne.
71' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
68' A pass from Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is intercepted by Emiliano Martinez and the move breaks down.
65' Substitution. Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) in, Leon Bailey out.
65' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Ollie Watkins and he is replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
65' Here is a change. Curtis Jones is going off and Arne Slot gives the last tactical orders to Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).
65' Substitution. Darwin Nunez did his best and is replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
63' Liverpool string together a series of short passes.
60' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
60' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Aston Villa, play can continue.

59' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Aston Villa.
59' PENALTY APPEAL by Aston Villa, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
57' A player from Aston Villa commits a rough challenge. David Coote blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick to Liverpool.
54' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:10.
51' Liverpool players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
48' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
46' The whistle blows and David Coote starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) sees a yellow card from David Coote after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
45+2' Jacob Ramsey is being substituted because of an injury. Unai Emery sends John McGinn (Aston Villa) on the pitch.
45+1' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

43' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
43' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) will take the corner.
40' The percentage of ball possession is – 56:44.
38' The referee signals a corner kick to Aston Villa.
38' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
37' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
36' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
34' David Coote shows a yellow card to Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
34' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
33' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just over the bar.
31' There's an opportunity for Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
29' A pass by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

27' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Darwin Nunez, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
25' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
25' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Conor Bradley replaces him.
23' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

20' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the roof of the net and makes it 1:0. Emiliano Martinez was helpless.
20' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.
18' The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
15' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
13' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
10' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
8' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.
6' David Coote interrupts the game. One of the players from Aston Villa won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Liverpool are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
3' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) commits a rough challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
David Coote got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
